subject: Discovery: QA matrix, model compatibility notes & stability next steps
messages:
From: Claire Dunne <claire@edgepay.io>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: roadmap questions + model update impact

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — useful overview. A couple of follow-ups from our product team: 1) Which Redwood model variants do you recommend for transaction categorization at ~1k qps with 90%+ precision? 2) Can you share any recent benchmark links and a sample prompt set we can run locally? 3) We heard that the latest model version pushed last week changed some labels unexpectedly (more "generic" classifications). Have you seen similar regressions, and what are the immediate mitigations?

We want to map these answers into our internal QA matrix so we can sign off quickly. Can you attach the sample prompts and any evaluation CSVs? Also, if possible, please propose a short set of next steps/timeline so we can coordinate legal/procurement.

Thanks — happy to loop Amit (infra) on technical bits.

Claire
Claire Dunne
Head of Product, EdgePay
---

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dunne <claire@edgepay.io>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@clearledger.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: roadmap questions + model update impact

Claire — great to meet earlier, thanks for the clear list. Attached are: prompt_set_customer_v1.json (sample prompts we used in the demo), and eval_results_v2.csv (recent bench vs. 3 candidate variants). High-level recommendations: 

- Recommended variants: rwd-1.7b-ops (default low-latency tradeoff), rwd-2.9b-stable (higher precision, slightly higher cost), and rwd-2.9b-stable-pin (snapshot of 2.9b before last week’s micro-update).
- Benchmarks: the attached CSV includes precision/recall by label and latency percentiles for 1k qps mix. For your workload, rwd-2.9b-stable gives ~92% precision on our transaction set and p95 latency ~120ms on dedicated pools.
- Regression note: we did observe an upstream micro-update that increased generic catches for a subset of vendor-provided tokens. We recommend: (a) running the attached prompt_set_customer_v1 locally against the rwd-2.9b-stable-pin snapshot, (b) if you see diffs, request we pin the model for your tenant while we triage.

Immediate next steps I propose: 
1) You run prompt_set_customer_v1 against the pinned snapshot (I can provision a 72-hour sandbox).
2) We share a short QA matrix mapping prompts -> expected label distributions (I included a starter table in the mutual action plan).
3) If diffs exceed your threshold, we open an ops ticket and apply a temporary pin/rollback for production traffic until fixes are validated.

I've attached a draft mutual_action_plan_edgepay.docx with timelines (target: sandbox by EOD Tuesday, 72h bake, decision window end-of-week). Links to more detailed metrics are below.

Attachments: [Attachment: prompt_set_customer_v1.json (json)] [Attachment: eval_results_v2.csv (csv)] [Attachment: mutual_action_plan_edgepay.docx (docx)]

Let me know if you want me to stand up the sandbox now — happy to do it and loop in Rishi/Soojin on the ops runbook.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Discovery follow-up: roadmap questions + model update impact — action items

Team — forwarding Claire's ask and the artifacts I sent. TL;DR: EdgePay needs a quick sandbox with a pinned snapshot and a QA matrix run. They found behavior changes after our recent micro-update; they're worried about label drift for high-value transactions.

Please confirm the following: 
- Rishi: can the infra team provision a 72-hour sandbox (dedicated small pool) with rwd-2.9b-stable-pin and telemetry enabled (token-level diffs, per-label counts)? Estimate time to provision and cost.
- Soojin: can your QA team run the prompt_set_customer_v1 and generate a short diff report (use current prod variant vs pinned snapshot) and populate the QA matrix in mutual_action_plan_edgepay.docx?
- Marissa: coordinate commercial note — if EdgePay wants a temporary pin in prod we need an Emergency Pin addendum (we've used a 30-day short-term pin charge). I'll draft recommended language.

I'm marking this as high-priority — EdgePay is in tight procurement cadence and wants visible remediation. If we can get a sandbox within 24 hours and a baked diff report in 72 hours, they will likely move forward with the PO. See attachments for starting data.

[Attachment: prompt_set_customer_v1.json (json)] [Attachment: eval_results_v2.csv (csv)] [Attachment: mutual_action_plan_edgepay.docx (docx)]

— Priyom

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Discovery follow-up: roadmap questions + model update impact — action items

Thanks Priyom — we can stand up a small dedicated pool with the rwd-2.9b-stable-pin snapshot by 2027-08-15T20:00 PDT (provisioning + config). We'll enable token-level telemetry and the per-label delta hooks you requested. Cost estimate: ~$1,200 for the 72h sandbox on a minimal reserved instance.

Rollback/pin runbook (short): 
1) Provision snapshot on isolated pool.
2) Route 5-10% of EdgePay test traffic to pinned pool for 24h.
3) Run Soojin's QA diff script and compare label histograms.
4) If diffs exceed thresholds, apply tenant-level pin for prod (apply through rollout page: https://redwood.app/ops/rollout/rdw-2319) and notify Sales/CS.
5) Ops will monitor for 48h and then coordinate handback to model team for permanent fix.

I will create the rollout ticket and add a runbook link. If you want me to include a DocuSign addendum template for the temporary pin I can draft that with Marissa.

— Rishi

From: Claire Dunne <claire@edgepay.io>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@clearledger.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: roadmap questions + model update impact

Priyom / Rishi — this is perfect, thanks. Two quick asks before we run the QA matrix: 1) Could you provision the 72-hour sandbox now (we're on a tight procurement clock)? 2) If possible, mirror a small production slice with our real routing keys so we can validate end-to-end behavior. We also want the temporary pinned tenant available so our fraud ops team can run manual reviews.

If you can confirm timelines and give a sandbox access link + credentials, we can begin tests immediately and aim to provide pass/fail within 48-72h. We'll sign the mutual action plan once the initial bake looks good.

Claire
